__comment: Sprint 049 #049-31: audit_log row count growth + retention/size monitoring. Sprint 048 impersonation writes 1 row per read -- projections on real clinic usage may have been conservative. Alert at 80% of 90-day retention window estimate.
title: SHI audit log growth

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM audit_log WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total FROM audit_log
SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_24h FROM audit_log WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM NOW() - MIN(created_at)) AS days FROM audit_log

panels.title: Impersonation action breakdown (last 7d)
panels.description: What's driving the audit_log volume. If impersonation.read:* dominates, the 30-min session limit is doing what it should; if impersonation.blocked_* dominates, a practitioner is running into the scope gate repeatedly.

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('hour', created_at) AS time, action, COUNT(*) AS rows FROM audit_log WHERE action LIKE 'impersonation.%' AND created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

__runbook: 1. Import into Grafana as a new dashboard.
2. Retention: audit_log is retained 90 days by default (see admin_settings table).
3. Alerts to configure on top of this dashboard:
- Size panel > 2GB -> warn (raises question of retention shortening OR partitioning).
- Rows/24h > 10x the 7-day median -> investigate (scraping? runaway impersonation session?).
- impersonation.blocked_write/out_of_scope > 100/day for any single user -> signal that the UX is confusing them.
